description: Shorti(쇼티) for «where was the camera?» or «폰 어디 두고 찍었어?». Where the phone stood in a hit, from its published scene. By `video` (a video_id or post link): its length and each phone set-up (Korean lines with lang='ko'), and the page that opens the scene in 3D; `none` when no scene is published.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

video.description: A hit's video_id or post link.

name: shorti_scene_get
title: Scene
